answer: A crystal-clear referral graph plus an escrow bond stops bulk fakes. Each newcomer locks 50 POA and names a sponsor, joining one visible chain. A fresh account is a lone knoll among clusters. Any peer may dispute an account; a jury of five checks it, and a proven fake loses its bond, its sponsor 25 POA. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its bond. A jetty admits only boats through its channel.
